title: Resize Canvas with precise placement
summary: Add transparent space or crop unused raster area using absolute or relative dimensions and nine placement anchors.

Added: Image > Resize Canvas offers Width/Height, signed relative dimensions, a nine-position placement grid, OK and Cancel.
Canvas edits retain original pixels, editable object styles and pointers, Undo/Redo and portable version2 project persistence.
Fixed: Integer canvas translations no longer alter text antialiasing or fractional arrow/callout stroke rasterization.
Verified: Native absolute/relative expansion, placement, invalid input and cut-object rejection, Escape/Cancel/title close, Undo/Redo and saving.

Independent comparison confirms355200 native output pixels, exact transparent padding and all seven translated objects.77 regular Rust tests cover placement, cropping, history, persistence and input validation.

limitations: Cropping across editable objects is rejected. Interactive crop and off-canvas object editing remain planned.
Canvas-changed projects use version2 and require this alpha or newer. Editable files are limited to160MB.
Committed reference Resize Canvas behavior remains unverified because its numeric inputs could not be changed through the inspection helper. Full UI parity is not claimed.
